Compliance Specialist

Sara Michels*, non-attorney professional

Sara Michels is a Compliance Specialist at The Political Law Group, where she supports the firm’s political compliance practice and assists with campaign finance reporting, research and regulatory requirements.

sara@tpl.group

Sara brings a background in political science, policy research, data analysis and administrative operations. Her graduate research focused on the relationship between state politics and education policy and included compiling, validating and analyzing financial and policy data from multiple public sources. She also brings experience with financial tracking, reporting and compliance-focused recordkeeping, including managing the budget and financial operations of a large membership organization.

*Denotes a non-attorney professional.

California State University, Sacramento, M.A., 2025 California State University, Fresno, B.A., 2022, magna cum laude
